envelope.description: Make tracker.sync repository-wide with an in-flight guard

body.title: Make tracker.sync repository-wide with an in-flight guard
body.summary: Let handleTrackerSync accept a call without an epicHash and refresh every Epic through refreshTrackerStatus, summarising the report in the existing result shape; a second repository-wide call for the same repository while one runs returns a skipped result at once. A call with an epicHash is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: tracker.sync with an epicHash returns exactly what it returned before
tracker.sync without an epicHash refreshes every Epic once and summarises synced, skipped or failed with the joined reasons
A second repository-wide call for the same repository while one is running returns a skipped result without starting another, and a call after the first ends runs normally

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/tracker-sync-method.test.ts: tracker.sync without an epicHash refreshes every Epic once, a second call while one runs is skipped, and a call with an epicHash is unchanged
